resources.string: Enable Lenovo AVB signing for locked devices. Signs Boot so compatible Lenovo devices can install images directly. Enable only for compatible Lenovo devices.
Leave unchecked for older versions. AOSP four-image signing applies to boot only; init_boot always uses non-chained signing.
Signs after all patches: chained for boot, non-chained for init_boot. Tap to configure newer AOSP signing.
Required · use images from the same firmware as boot
Select all required signing images before continuing.
Uses the current slot. Signs after all patches, verifies the complete image set and writes it with rollback backups.
